title: edit always replaces; there is no way to append

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`ops.edit_section` assigns the body. With `--file` or `--stdin` you always replace, so
adding a line to a section non-interactively means reading it back with `show --json`,
concatenating, and writing the whole thing. The `$EDITOR` path pre-seeds the buffer, so
the ergonomic affordance exists interactively and nowhere else.

Appending is what an agent does most: record what it found, add a failing test to the
list, note a decision.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
`slicer edit ID --section NAME --append`, with `--file`/`--stdin` as the source. Decide
the joining rule explicitly — a blank line between old and new is right for markdown.

**Not in this slice:** editing several sections in one call.
